title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）~Confederation Bridge
focus: 以冰盾錐體、超大型預製構件與百年耐久設計，跨越冬季浮冰的諾森伯蘭海峽~Crossing the ice-covered Northumberland Strait with ice-shield cones, very large precast components and a 100-year durability design
summary: 聯邦大橋連接愛德華王子島與新布倫瑞克省，全長約 12.9 公里，是跨越冬季結冰海域最長的橋梁，主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑排列，設計壽命 100 年。本課從浮冰荷載與冰盾錐體出發，拆解主梁懸臂與掛梁組成的預製體系、高性能混凝土與墩身接合，再看陸上預製場、浮吊 Svanen 與高峰期每週一跨的安裝節奏，最後談冰力監測、強風管制、除冰鹽與凍融，以及 2032 年特許營運結束時的交接。~Confederation Bridge links Prince Edward Island and New Brunswick over about 12.9 km, the longest bridge over ice-covered water, with main spans of about 250 m and a 100-year design life. Starting from pack-ice loads and the ice-shield cones, the course unpacks the precast system of cantilevered main girders and drop-in spans, high-performance concrete and pier joints, then the land casting yard, the floating crane Svanen and a peak rate of one span a week, ending with ice-force monitoring, wind restrictions, de-icing salt and freeze–thaw, and the handover when the concession ends in 2032.

units.title: 海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體~Pack ice and the ice-shield cones
units.mechanism: 諾森伯蘭海峽每年冬季被浮冰覆蓋，冰板隨潮流與風移動，撞到橋墩時會產生很大的水平力。若墩身在水線處是垂直面，冰板只能被壓碎，力量由冰的抗壓強度決定；聯邦大橋在每座墩的水線處設置錐形冰盾，讓冰板沿斜面爬升而以彎曲方式斷裂，冰的抗彎強度遠低於抗壓強度，因此傳到墩身的力大幅降低。錐體也讓碎冰順利從墩旁流走，避免冰塊在墩前堆積造成更大的推力或阻塞海流。~The Northumberland Strait is covered in pack ice every winter, and ice sheets driven by tide and wind exert large horizontal forces on piers. With a vertical face at the waterline the ice can only crush, with force set by its compressive strength; Confederation Bridge has a conical ice shield at the waterline of each pier so that the sheet rides up the slope and fails in bending, and because ice is far weaker in bending than in compression, the force on the pier drops sharply. The cone also lets broken ice clear past the pier instead of piling up in front of it, where rubble would push harder and obstruct the flow.
units.model: 垂直面壓碎力 F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D：σ_c = 2.0 MPa、冰厚 h = 0.6 m、水線寬 D = 14 m，F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN。錐面彎曲破壞力以簡化式 F_b ≈ k·σ_f·h²：k = 10、σ_f = 0.7 MPa，F_b ≈ 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN，約為壓碎力的 1/6.7。所有參數為教學假設。~Crushing on a vertical face F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D: with σ_c = 2.0 MPa, ice thickness h = 0.6 m and waterline width D = 14 m, F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN. Bending failure on a cone, by a simplified F_b ≈ k·σ_f·h² with k = 10 and σ_f = 0.7 MPa, gives F_b ≈ 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN, about 1/6.7 of the crushing force. All parameters are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計時以海冰觀測資料統計冰厚、冰速與冰強度，並以冰槽模型試驗或數值模擬比較錐體與垂直面的冰力；營運期在代表性墩位量測墩身傾斜、加速度或應變，配合冰況觀測反算實際冰力，與設計值比較。~At design stage derive ice thickness, speed and strength statistics from observations and compare cone and vertical-face ice forces in ice-tank model tests or simulations; in service measure tilt, acceleration or strain on representative piers and back-calculate actual ice forces from observed ice conditions for comparison with design.
units.failure: 若冰盾角度或位置與實際水位、潮差不配合，冰板在高潮或低潮時打到錐體以外的垂直墩身，力量回到壓碎模式；冰塊在墩前堆積成冰脊時，作用力與作用高度都超出單層冰板的假設，墩身承受額外彎矩。~If the cone angle or elevation does not match actual water levels and tides, ice strikes the vertical shaft above or below the cone at high or low water and the force returns to crushing; rubble ridges piling in front of a pier exceed the single-sheet assumption in both force and height, adding bending to the shaft.
units.misconception: 冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。~Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible.
units.practice: 冰區橋梁的設計基準應明列冰厚、冰強度、冰速與水位組合，冰盾的有效高程範圍要涵蓋設計潮差與風暴潮；營運手冊規定冰季巡查項目，例如墩前冰堆積、錐面磨損與異常振動。~The design basis for an ice-exposed bridge should list combinations of ice thickness, strength, speed and water level, and the cone's effective elevation range must cover design tides and storm surge; the operating manual sets ice-season patrol items such as rubble build-up, cone wear and unusual vibration.

units.anchor: 主梁懸臂與中央掛梁~Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins
units.title: 250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系~Precast system for the 250 m spans
units.mechanism: 主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑重複排列，上部結構是後拉預力混凝土箱梁。公開資料指出，主墩、主梁與掛梁都在陸上預製：主梁跨坐在墩頂、向兩側懸臂伸出，相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端之間再放入一段較短的掛梁，組成完整跨徑。這種體系讓最重的構件在陸上完成，海上只需要放置、對位與連接；但懸臂根部承受極大的負彎矩，必須靠深梁高與大量預力承擔，而掛梁兩端的連接決定了行車平順與伸縮行為。~The main bridge repeats spans of about 250 m, with post-tensioned concrete box girders. Public sources state that the main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were all precast on land: a main girder sits astride a pier and cantilevers both ways, and a shorter drop-in span fills the gap between the cantilever tips of adjacent main girders to complete each span. The system keeps the heaviest work on land, leaving placement, alignment and connection at sea; but the cantilever roots carry very large hogging moments that require great depth and heavy prestress, and the drop-in connections govern ride quality and movement behaviour.
units.model: 主梁每側懸臂 a = 95 m、自重 w = 300 kN/m，懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m；60 m 掛梁以 w = 200 kN/m 簡支計，跨中彎矩 M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m，只約為前者的 1/15。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。~With 95 m cantilevers each side and self-weight w = 300 kN/m, the root moment is M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m; a 60 m drop-in span at w = 200 kN/m, simply supported, has M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m, only about 1/15 of the former. Dimensions and loads are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段模型檢查主梁在吊裝、存放與就位時的應力（支點位置不同時彎矩會反轉），並以長期分析預測懸臂端撓度；就位後量測懸臂端高程與掛梁支座位置，確認與預測一致才進行連接。~Check main-girder stresses in lifting, storage and placement with a staged model, since moments reverse as support positions change, and predict long-term tip deflections; after placement survey tip levels and drop-in seat positions and connect only when they match predictions.
units.failure: 主梁預力或梁高不足時，懸臂根部頂板在長期潛變與活載下開裂；相鄰懸臂端撓度不同時，掛梁兩端產生高差，造成行車跳動與伸縮裝置損壞。~Insufficient prestress or depth cracks the top slab at the cantilever root under long-term creep and live load; unequal tip deflections of adjacent cantilevers leave a step at the drop-in ends, causing ride bumps and expansion-device damage.
units.misconception: 預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。~Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete.
units.practice: 設計文件應同時提供每個構件在吊裝、運輸、存放與就位各階段的支承條件與允許應力，並以懸臂端長期撓度預測訂定掛梁座的預留高程；就位與連接順序列為停留點。~Design documents should give support conditions and allowable stresses for every component during lifting, transport, storage and placement, and set the drop-in seat levels from long-term tip-deflection predictions; placement and connection sequences are hold points.

units.title: 百年設計壽命的材料選擇~Materials for a 100-year design life
units.mechanism: 聯邦大橋的合約要求 100 年設計壽命，約為一般橋梁的兩倍，公開資料指出預製構件使用高等級混凝土與鋼筋來達成。海峽環境同時有三種劣化：海水氯離子讓鋼筋腐蝕、冬季凍融循環讓混凝土表層剝落、浮冰在水線處反覆磨蝕冰盾表面。高性能混凝土以低水膠比與卜作嵐材料降低滲透性，並以適當的氣泡系統抵抗凍融；在冰磨蝕最嚴重的水線帶，常再加大保護層或提高表面耐磨性，把部分厚度當作可犧牲層。~The contract required a 100-year design life, about twice that of ordinary bridges, and public sources say high-grade concrete and reinforcement in the precast components were used to achieve it. The strait combines three deterioration modes: seawater chlorides corrode reinforcement, winter freeze–thaw cycles scale the concrete surface, and pack ice repeatedly abrades the ice shields at the waterline. High-performance concrete lowers permeability with a low water–binder ratio and pozzolans and resists freeze–thaw with a suitable air-void system; in the waterline band where ice abrasion is worst, cover is often increased or surface abrasion resistance raised, treating part of the thickness as sacrificial.
units.model: 若水線帶冰磨蝕率取 0.5 mm/年，100 年損失 0.5×100 = 50 mm；設計保護層 75 mm 時，只剩約 25 mm 保護鋼筋，因此需要加大保護層或耐磨面層。若磨蝕率降為 0.2 mm/年，損失只有 20 mm。磨蝕率與保護層為教學假設。~If ice abrades the waterline band at 0.5 mm a year, 100 years remove 0.5×100 = 50 mm; with 75 mm cover only about 25 mm would remain over the steel, so larger cover or an abrasion-resistant layer is needed. At 0.2 mm a year the loss is only 20 mm. Abrasion rates and cover are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 配比驗證包含抗壓強度、氯離子滲透、凍融耐久（例如 ASTM C666）與氣泡間距係數；預製場逐批抽驗並保存試驗紀錄；營運期在水線帶定期量測磨蝕深度與保護層剩餘厚度，建立劣化速率。~Mix qualification includes compressive strength, chloride penetration, freeze–thaw durability (for example ASTM C666) and air-void spacing factor; the casting yard tests every batch and keeps records; in service the waterline band is measured periodically for abrasion depth and remaining cover to establish deterioration rates.
units.failure: 若混凝土氣泡系統不足，凍融循環使表層逐年剝落，保護層變薄、氯離子更快到達鋼筋；水線帶磨蝕若未監測，數十年後鋼筋外露，修補必須在冰季以外的短窗口進行，代價很高。~A deficient air-void system lets freeze–thaw scale the surface year by year, thinning cover so chlorides reach the steel sooner; unmonitored waterline abrasion can expose reinforcement after decades, and repairs must fit short windows outside the ice season at great cost.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。~High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
units.practice: 耐久規範應依暴露區（水下、潮汐、浪濺、水線冰磨、橋面）分別訂定保護層、配比與試驗要求，預製場的品質紀錄須逐構件追溯；在水線帶預設量測點，作為日後磨蝕評估的基準。~The durability specification should set cover, mix and test requirements by exposure zone (submerged, tidal, splash, waterline ice abrasion, deck), with yard quality records traceable to each component; reference points in the waterline band provide a baseline for future abrasion surveys.

units.anchor: 墩座與墩身接合面~Pier base-to-shaft joint
units.title: 預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合~Joining bases, shafts and ice shields
units.mechanism: 每座主墩由多個大型預製件組成：坐在海床上的墩座、帶有冰盾的墩身，以及上方的主梁。構件之間的接合面必須同時傳遞巨大的垂直力、冰與風造成的水平力和彎矩，通常以灌漿填平接觸面，再以後拉預力把構件壓成一體。灌漿層讓不完全平整的接觸面均勻受力，預力則讓接合面在設計荷載下維持受壓、不張開，否則海水會進入接縫腐蝕預力鋼材。接合面的摩擦抗剪也是抵抗浮冰水平推力的主要機制。~Each main pier is assembled from large precast pieces: a base seated on the seabed, a shaft carrying the ice shield, and the main girder above. Joints between them must transmit huge vertical loads together with horizontal forces and moments from ice and wind, typically by grouting the contact faces and post-tensioning the pieces together. The grout layer spreads load over imperfect contact surfaces, and prestress keeps the joint in compression under design loads so it does not open, otherwise seawater would enter and corrode the tendons. Friction across the joint is also the main mechanism resisting horizontal ice thrust.
units.model: 剪力摩擦 V_cap = μ·N。若接合面上方承受主梁重 7,500 t（N = 7,500×9.81 ≈ 73,600 kN）、摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，V_cap ≈ 0.6×73,600 ≈ 44,100 kN，遠大於錐面冰力 2.52 MN，也大於垂直面壓碎力 16.8 MN。重量與 μ 為教學假設；實際設計還需加上預力與抗剪鍵。~Shear friction V_cap = μ·N. With a 7,500 t main girder above the joint (N = 7,500×9.81 ≈ 73,600 kN) and μ = 0.6, V_cap ≈ 0.6×73,600 ≈ 44,100 kN, far above the 2.52 MN cone ice force and also above the 16.8 MN crushing force. Weight and μ are teaching assumptions; real design also adds prestress and shear keys.
units.verify: 構件就位後以 GNSS 與全站儀量測平面位置、高程與垂直度，公開資料指出定位精度可達約 2 cm；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力並確認溢漿，預力張拉逐束記錄伸長量與油壓，與計算比較；接縫以目視與潛水檢查確認無漏漿與張開。~After placement survey plan position, level and plumb by GNSS and total station, with public sources citing placement to about 2 cm; during grouting record volume and pressure and confirm vent overflow; record elongation and jack pressure for each tendon against calculation; inspect joints visually and by divers for grout leaks or opening.
units.failure: 接觸面灌漿不完整時，荷載集中在少數接觸點，局部壓碎並在預力作用下產生裂縫；預力損失或接縫張開讓海水進入孔道，預力鋼材腐蝕而無法目視發現，是預製海事結構最危險的隱蔽劣化。~Incomplete joint grouting concentrates load on a few contact points, crushing them locally and cracking under prestress; prestress loss or joint opening lets seawater into ducts and corrodes tendons invisibly, the most dangerous hidden deterioration in precast marine structures.
units.misconception: 預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。~Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
units.practice: 接合程序應依序設停留點：接觸面清潔與量測、灌漿與溢漿確認、預力張拉與紀錄、孔道灌漿與封錨；每個接縫建立紀錄卡，交接時納入營運資料，作為日後檢查預力狀態的依據。~The joining procedure should have sequential hold points: surface cleaning and survey, grouting with vent confirmation, tendon stressing with records, duct grouting and anchor sealing; every joint gets a record card that enters the operating file as the basis for later checks of tendon condition.

units.anchor: 陸上預製場與重件運輸~Land casting yard and heavy transport
units.title: 預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨~The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week
units.mechanism: 主墩、主梁與掛梁都在愛德華王子島博登—卡爾頓附近的預製場製作，構件在場內以履帶式運輸車沿軌道移動到存放區與碼頭，再由浮吊 Svanen 運到海上吊放。公開資料提到全橋約有 175 件主要構件，最重約 7,500 公噸，高峰期每週可完成一跨。把海上工作化為陸上工廠作業，品質與進度較能掌控，但整個工程的節奏取決於預製場產能、存放空間、浮吊與海況，以及每年冰季前必須完成的安裝窗口。~The main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were made at a casting yard near Borden-Carleton, Prince Edward Island, moved within the yard by crawler transporters on rails to storage and the wharf, and then carried out and placed by the floating crane Svanen. Public sources mention about 175 major structural pieces, the heaviest about 7,500 t, with one span completed each week at the peak. Turning marine work into a land factory improves control of quality and schedule, but the pace of the whole job depends on yard output, storage space, the crane, sea conditions and the installation window that must close before each ice season.
units.model: 主橋 44 跨、每跨約 4 件主要構件（墩座、墩身、主梁、掛梁），共約 44×4 = 176 件，與公開的約 175 件相符。若兩個無冰施工季各 30 週、共 60 週，平均每週需完成 44/60 ≈ 0.73 跨；高峰期每週一跨表示每週約 4 次重件吊放。每跨構件數與施工週數為教學假設。~With 44 main spans and about 4 major pieces each (base, shaft, main girder, drop-in), there are about 44×4 = 176 pieces, consistent with the published figure of about 175. If two ice-free seasons of 30 weeks each give 60 weeks, the average rate must be 44/60 ≈ 0.73 spans a week; a peak of one span a week means about 4 heavy lifts a week. Pieces per span and season length are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以預製、存放、運輸與吊放的排程模擬檢查產能瓶頸；每件構件出場前檢查強度、尺寸、預埋件與吊點，並秤重確認；每次吊放前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與冰況，吊放後量測位置並記錄，作為下一件構件的修正依據。~Simulate the schedule of casting, storage, transport and lifting to find bottlenecks; before each piece leaves the yard check strength, dimensions, embedded items and lifting points and weigh it; before each lift confirm wave, wind and ice forecasts, then survey and record the placed position as the correction basis for the next piece.
units.failure: 預製場進度落後時，安裝被推遲到秋末，冰季提前來臨使部分墩位暴露在未完成狀態下過冬；重件在存放區支承不當時，構件可能在吊裝前就出現裂縫。~If the yard falls behind, installation slips into late autumn and an early ice season leaves some piers to winter in an unfinished state; heavy pieces stored on poorly placed supports can crack before they are ever lifted.
units.misconception: 只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。~With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
units.practice: 整體施工計畫應以冰季為硬性約束，訂定每季必須完成的墩位與越冬安全狀態；預製場與海上作業共用一套構件追蹤系統，記錄每件的製造、檢驗、存放與安裝資料，交接時完整移交。~The overall programme should treat the ice season as a hard constraint, fixing which piers must be complete each season and the safe overwintering state; yard and marine operations share one component-tracking system recording fabrication, inspection, storage and installation of every piece, handed over in full.

units.anchor: 掛梁就位與懸臂端高差~Drop-in seating and tip level difference
units.title: 主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制~Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment
units.mechanism: 主梁放上墩頂後，兩側懸臂端會在自重與預力作用下產生撓度，並隨混凝土潛變與收縮持續變化；掛梁放入時，兩端支座的高程取決於相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端撓度。如果相鄰主梁的製造齡期、預力或放置時間不同，兩者的潛變速率不同，掛梁兩端就會出現高差。線形控制因此必須以時間為變數：預測每支主梁在放置掛梁時與長期的撓度，調整掛梁座高程或墊片，讓完工後的橋面縱斷面平順。~Once a main girder is set on its pier, both cantilever tips deflect under self-weight and prestress and keep moving with creep and shrinkage; when a drop-in is placed, its seat levels depend on the tip deflections of the two neighbouring main girders. If those girders differ in casting age, prestress or placement date, their creep rates differ and the drop-in ends end up at different levels. Alignment control must therefore treat time as a variable: predict each girder's deflection at drop-in placement and in the long term, and adjust seat levels or shims so the finished profile is smooth.
units.model: 懸臂端彈性撓度 40 mm，長期撓度 ≈ δ_el·(1+φ)。若甲主梁放置時齡期較長、φ = 1.5，長期撓度 40×2.5 = 100 mm；乙主梁較年輕、φ = 2.0，長期撓度 40×3.0 = 120 mm；兩端高差約 20 mm，需在掛梁座預留調整。數值為教學假設。~Elastic tip deflection is 40 mm and long-term deflection ≈ δ_el·(1+φ). An older girder with φ = 1.5 reaches 40×2.5 = 100 mm, while a younger one with φ = 2.0 reaches 40×3.0 = 120 mm; the 20 mm difference must be allowed for at the drop-in seats. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每支主梁從預製到放置定期量測懸臂端高程，以實測撓度修正潛變模型；掛梁就位前量測兩端座高差並依預測決定墊片厚度，完工後與一年後各量測一次全線縱斷面，確認長期變形符合預測。~Measure tip levels of every main girder periodically from casting to placement and update the creep model with measured deflections; before seating a drop-in survey the seat level difference and choose shim thickness from predictions; survey the full profile at completion and again after a year to confirm long-term behaviour.
units.failure: 若只依設計理想齡期調整掛梁座，而實際施工順序改變，部分掛梁兩端高差逐年擴大，造成行車跳動、伸縮裝置受衝擊與防水層破壞；長期撓度大於預測時，橋面縱斷面出現連續起伏。~Setting drop-in seats for ideal design ages when the actual sequence changed lets level differences grow year by year, causing ride bumps, impact on expansion devices and torn waterproofing; long-term deflections larger than predicted leave a repeating wave in the profile.
units.misconception: 預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。~Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.
units.practice: 線形控制應有專責小組，建立每支主梁的齡期、預力與撓度紀錄，施工順序變更時重新預測並調整掛梁座；墊片或調整量的決定與實測值一併歸檔，交接後供維護單位判讀變形。~A dedicated alignment team should keep age, prestress and deflection records for every main girder, re-predict and adjust seats whenever the sequence changes, and file each shim decision with its measurements for maintenance staff to interpret deformation after handover.

units.title: 冰力與結構反應監測~Monitoring ice forces and response
units.mechanism: 冰力的設計值帶有很大的不確定性：冰的強度隨溫度、鹽度與加載速率變化，冰板厚度與漂移速度年年不同。在代表性墩位裝設傾斜計、加速度計或應變計，再配合冰況觀測（冰厚、冰速、破壞模式），可以從結構反應反算實際冰力，檢驗設計假設，並為其他冰區橋梁累積資料。監測也能發現冰盾磨損或墩前堆冰改變受力模式的情況，作為冰季巡查與維修的依據。~Design ice forces carry large uncertainty: ice strength varies with temperature, salinity and loading rate, and sheet thickness and drift speed change from year to year. Tiltmeters, accelerometers or strain gauges on representative piers, combined with ice observations of thickness, speed and failure mode, let engineers back-calculate actual ice forces from structural response, test design assumptions and build data for other ice-exposed bridges. Monitoring also reveals when shield wear or rubble build-up changes the loading mode, guiding ice-season patrols and repairs.
units.model: 以墩身轉動勁度 k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad 反算：量到冰作用時墩頂附加傾角 θ = 20 μrad，彎矩 M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m；若作用點到轉動中心的力臂 30 m，冰力 F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN。勁度與力臂為教學假設。~Back-calculate with a pier rotational stiffness k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad: an extra tilt θ = 20 μrad during an ice event gives M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m, and with a 30 m lever arm to the rotation centre the ice force is F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN. Stiffness and lever arm are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 先以已知荷載（例如載重車或拉索施力）標定墩身的轉動勁度，再於冰季連續記錄傾角、溫度與冰況影像；以溫度修正排除日照造成的傾斜，比較反算冰力的統計分布與設計冰力，並檢查最大事件發生時的冰厚與破壞模式。~First calibrate the pier's rotational stiffness with a known load such as test trucks or a cable pull, then log tilt, temperature and ice imagery continuously through the ice season; remove sun-induced tilt by temperature correction, compare the statistical distribution of back-calculated forces with design ice loads, and check ice thickness and failure mode during the largest events.
units.failure: 若未做溫度修正，日照造成的墩身傾斜會被誤判為冰力，得出偏高或偏低的結論；感測器在冰季失效而未及時更換，正好錯過最需要的資料。~Without temperature correction, sun-induced tilt is mistaken for ice load and leads to wrong conclusions; sensors that fail during the ice season and are not replaced miss exactly the data that matter most.
units.misconception: 冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。~Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
units.practice: 監測計畫應明訂標定方法、溫度修正、資料品質檢查與冰況同步觀測的方式，並指定判讀人員與年度報告格式；異常冰力事件後須進行墩身與冰盾的特別檢查。~The monitoring plan should define calibration, temperature correction, data-quality checks and synchronised ice observation, name the analysts and the annual report format, and require special inspection of pier and shield after any abnormal ice-force event.

units.title: 強風管制與高側車輛~Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles
units.mechanism: 橋面大部分高出海面約 40 公尺，航道段最高約 60 公尺，海峽上的強風對結構通常不是控制因素，卻直接威脅高側車輛、空車拖車與機車的行車安全。營運單位在橋上設置風速計，官方網站每 6 分鐘更新持續風速與陣風，超過門檻時實施分級限制，例如禁止特定車種或降低速限。這是一種以量測支撐營運決策的措施：門檻值由車輛傾覆與側滑的力學計算決定，並以實際事故與風速紀錄修正。~Most of the deck is about 40 m above the sea and up to about 60 m at the navigation span; strong winds over the strait rarely govern the structure but directly threaten high-sided vehicles, empty trailers and motorcycles. The operator runs deck anemometers, and its website updates sustained winds and gusts every six minutes, triggering staged restrictions such as banning certain vehicle types or lowering speed limits when thresholds are exceeded. It is a measurement-based operating decision: thresholds come from the mechanics of vehicle overturning and sliding, refined with incident and wind records.
units.model: 陣風 107 km/h = 29.7 m/s，q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa。空拖車側面積 39 m²、側力係數 1.2：F = 541×1.2×39 ≈ 25.3 kN，作用高度 2.0 m，傾覆彎矩約 50.6 kN·m。空車重 80 kN、輪距半寬 1.0 m，抗傾覆彎矩 80 kN·m，安全係數約 1.58；滿載 300 kN 時約 5.9。車輛參數為教學假設。~A 107 km/h gust is 29.7 m/s, so q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa. An empty trailer with 39 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.2 sees F = 541×1.2×39 ≈ 25.3 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of about 50.6 kN·m. Weighing 80 kN with a half-track of 1.0 m, it resists 80 kN·m, a factor of about 1.58; loaded to 300 kN the factor is about 5.9. Vehicle parameters are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 風速計的位置、高度與遮蔽需與設計風場一致，並定期校正；以多年風速紀錄統計超過各門檻的時數，評估交通中斷的頻率；事故或車輛偏移事件發生時，回查當時風速與限制狀態，檢討門檻是否適當。~Anemometer position, height and shelter must match the design wind field, with regular calibration; multi-year wind records give the hours above each threshold and thus closure frequency; after incidents or vehicle drift events, review the wind speed and restriction status at the time to judge whether thresholds are right.
units.failure: 風速計被結構或護欄遮蔽、量測偏低時，限制發布太晚，空車或高側車輛可能在陣風中偏移撞擊護欄甚至傾覆；門檻過於保守則頻繁封閉，影響島上物流與民生。~An anemometer sheltered by the structure or barriers reads low and restrictions come too late, so empty or high-sided vehicles can drift into barriers or overturn in gusts; overly conservative thresholds close the bridge often and disrupt island logistics and daily life.
units.misconception: 只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。~If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
units.practice: 營運手冊應列出各車種的風速門檻、量測來源、發布與解除程序及通報管道，並每年以事故與風速資料檢討；更換護欄或在橋面加裝設施時，須確認不影響風速計的代表性。~The operating manual should list wind thresholds by vehicle type, measurement sources, procedures for issuing and lifting restrictions and communication channels, reviewed annually with incident and wind data; replacing barriers or adding deck equipment must not compromise anemometer representativeness.

units.anchor: 橋面防水與鋪面~Deck waterproofing and surfacing
units.title: 除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修~De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing
units.mechanism: 冬季除冰鹽讓橋面混凝土承受高濃度氯離子，加上反覆凍融，是橋面板最主要的劣化來源。橋面防水層與瀝青鋪面的任務就是把水和鹽擋在結構混凝土之外；營運單位說明 2015 年做過微表處理，近期又進行自通車以來最大規模的鋪面更新，目的之一正是防止水與除冰鹽進入結構橋面板，以確保 100 年壽命。鋪面是犧牲層，必須定期更換；施工時刨除舊鋪面若傷及防水層或橋面板，反而會縮短結構壽命。~Winter de-icing salt loads the deck concrete with high chloride concentrations, which together with repeated freeze–thaw is the main deterioration source for the deck slab. The waterproofing membrane and asphalt surfacing exist to keep water and salt out of the structural concrete; the operator explains that micro-surfacing was done in 2015 and that a recent resurfacing, the largest since opening, aimed partly at keeping water and de-icing salt out of the structural deck to secure the 100-year life. Surfacing is a sacrificial layer that must be renewed periodically, and milling that damages the membrane or the slab shortens the structure's life instead.
units.model: ASTM C666 耐久因數 DF = P·N/M：300 次凍融循環後相對動彈性模數 P = 90%，DF = 90×300/300 = 90。若每年約 60 次凍融、100 年約 6,000 次，遠多於試驗的 300 次，所以試驗結果只能作為配比比較，必須配合防水層把橋面混凝土保持在低含水狀態。凍融次數為教學假設。~ASTM C666 durability factor DF = P·N/M: with relative dynamic modulus P = 90% after 300 cycles, DF = 90×300/300 = 90. At about 60 freeze–thaw cycles a year, 100 years bring about 6,000 cycles, far beyond the 300 tested, so the test only ranks mixes and the membrane must keep the deck concrete dry. The cycle count is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 鋪面翻修前以透地雷達或鑽心檢查防水層與橋面板狀況，刨除時控制刨深並檢查有無傷及防水層；新鋪面驗收壓實度、厚度與平整度；定期在代表性位置量測橋面板氯離子含量與半電池電位，追蹤腐蝕風險。~Before resurfacing check the membrane and slab by ground-penetrating radar or cores, control milling depth and look for membrane damage; accept the new surfacing on compaction, thickness and smoothness; periodically measure chloride content and half-cell potential at representative deck locations to track corrosion risk.
units.failure: 鋪面裂縫與坑洞若長期不修，鹽水直接滲入橋面板，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹使橋面板底部剝落；刨除過深傷到防水層後重鋪，表面看似全新，內部卻失去防水保護。~Long-unrepaired cracks and potholes let brine soak into the slab, and corroding bars spall its soffit; milling too deep and damaging the membrane before repaving leaves a surface that looks new while the deck has lost its waterproofing.
units.misconception: 鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。~Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
units.practice: 鋪面翻修規範應包含刨深控制、防水層檢查與修補、交通維持與冬季前完工的期限；每次翻修後更新橋面板狀況紀錄，並在交接文件中記錄防水層系統與歷次翻修資料。~Resurfacing specifications should cover milling-depth control, membrane inspection and repair, traffic management and a completion deadline before winter; update the deck condition record after each campaign and include the membrane system and resurfacing history in handover documents.

units.title: 特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接~Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer
units.mechanism: 聯邦大橋屬於加拿大聯邦資產，由 Strait Crossing 公司依 1993 年協議設計、興建、融資、營運與維護，營運期至 2032 年，之後移交加拿大政府；公共服務及採購部表示仍進行年度檢查與預防性維護。這種長期特許模式把維護責任與收費收入綁在一起，但移交時點的狀態定義至關重要：新管理者需要知道結構已用掉多少壽命、哪些構件接近劣化門檻、哪些監測資料可用。交接文件因此要回答「現況是否符合百年設計壽命的軌跡」。~Confederation Bridge is a federal asset designed, built, financed, operated and maintained by Strait Crossing under 1993 agreements, operating until 2032 when it passes to the Government of Canada; Public Services and Procurement Canada states that it continues annual inspections and preventive maintenance. Such a long concession ties maintenance to toll revenue, but defining condition at the transfer date is critical: the new manager must know how much life has been used, which components are near deterioration thresholds and what monitoring data exist. Handover documents must therefore answer whether the bridge is on track for its 100-year life.
units.model: 1997 年通車到 2032 年移交共 35 年，佔 100 年設計壽命的 35/100 = 35%，剩餘約 65 年（2016 年預算官報告估計壽命至 2097 年）。若某暴露區預測在第 60 年開始腐蝕，即約 2057 年，移交後只有 25 年可規劃修繕。腐蝕起始年份為教學假設。~From opening in 1997 to transfer in 2032 is 35 years, 35/100 = 35% of the design life, leaving about 65 years (a 2016 budget-officer report put the end of life at 2097). If one exposure zone is predicted to start corroding at year 60, about 2057, only 25 years remain after transfer to plan repairs. The initiation year is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 移交前由雙方共同委託獨立檢查，依構件逐項評定狀況等級，並以氯離子剖面、保護層、預力孔道與冰盾磨蝕的量測資料推估剩餘壽命；比較歷年年度檢查紀錄的趨勢，確認劣化速率與百年設計的假設一致。~Before transfer both parties commission an independent inspection that rates every component, and estimate remaining life from chloride profiles, cover, tendon-duct and ice-shield abrasion data; compare trends in years of annual inspection records to confirm deterioration rates consistent with the 100-year assumptions.
units.failure: 若移交只看外觀而未量測隱蔽劣化，新管理者可能在接手數年後才發現預力孔道或橋面板的嚴重問題，修繕責任與費用產生爭議；監測資料格式不明或基準遺失，則多年資料無法比較。~A transfer based on appearance without measuring hidden deterioration may leave the new manager discovering serious tendon or deck problems a few years later, with disputes over responsibility and cost; unclear data formats or lost baselines make years of monitoring incomparable.
units.misconception: 特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。~If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good.
units.practice: 特許合約應事先訂定移交時的狀態標準、必須提交的檢查與量測資料、剩餘壽命評估方法與缺失處理方式；移交文件包含竣工圖、構件履歷、年度檢查、監測資料與維修紀錄，並由獨立工程師簽認。~The concession agreement should define in advance the condition standard at transfer, required inspection and measurement data, the remaining-life method and how defects are handled; transfer documents include as-built drawings, component histories, annual inspections, monitoring data and repair records, signed off by an independent engineer.

example: 冰盾設計練習：某主墩水線寬 D = 14 m，設計冰厚 h = 0.6 m。垂直面壓碎力 F_c = σ_c·h·D = 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN；錐面彎曲破壞力 F_b = k·σ_f·h² = 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN。冰力作用點到墩座接合面的力臂取 25 m，彎矩分別為 16.8×25 = 420 MN·m 與 2.52×25 = 63 MN·m。接合面面積 A = 40 m²、斷面模數 S = 60 m³，彎曲應力分別為 420/60 = 7.0 MPa 與 63/60 = 1.05 MPa。若上方主梁重 7,500 t（約 73.6 MN），平均壓應力 73.6/40 ≈ 1.84 MPa：錐面情況下 1.84 > 1.05，接合面不會張開；垂直面情況下需再增加約 (7.0 − 1.84)×40 ≈ 206 MN 的預力才能保持全斷面受壓。結論是冰盾錐體大幅減少了墩身與接合面所需的預力。數值為教學假設，不代表聯邦大橋的設計。~Ice-shield exercise: a main pier is D = 14 m wide at the waterline with design ice thickness h = 0.6 m. Crushing on a vertical face gives F_c = σ_c·h·D = 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN; bending failure on a cone gives F_b = k·σ_f·h² = 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN. With a 25 m lever arm to the base joint, the moments are 16.8×25 = 420 MN·m and 2.52×25 = 63 MN·m. For a joint area A = 40 m² and section modulus S = 60 m³, the bending stresses are 420/60 = 7.0 MPa and 63/60 = 1.05 MPa. A 7,500 t girder above (about 73.6 MN) gives an average compression of 73.6/40 ≈ 1.84 MPa: with the cone, 1.84 > 1.05 and the joint stays closed; with a vertical face about (7.0 − 1.84)×40 ≈ 206 MN of extra prestress would be needed to keep the section in compression. The cone therefore greatly reduces the prestress demand on shaft and joint. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Confederation Bridge design.
history: 愛德華王子島 1873 年加入加拿大時，聯邦政府承諾提供全年渡輪服務；1988 年島上公投以約 60% 支持興建固定通道。1993 年加拿大政府與 Strait Crossing 簽署設計、興建、融資、營運與維護協議，由多跨預製混凝土橋梁專家 Jean Muller 參與設計，同年 10 月開工；大型構件在陸上預製後由浮吊 Svanen 安裝，主體結構於 1996 年 11 月完成，1997 年 5 月 31 日通車。其工程新意在於以錐形冰盾降低浮冰荷載、以超大型預製構件縮短冰季限制下的海上作業，以及合約明訂 100 年設計壽命。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。~When Prince Edward Island joined Canada in 1873, the federal government promised year-round ferry service; in 1988 islanders voted about 60% in favour of a fixed link. In 1993 the Government of Canada signed design, build, finance, operate and maintain agreements with Strait Crossing, with Jean Muller, a specialist in multi-span precast concrete bridges, as designer, and work began that October; large components were precast on land and placed by the floating crane Svanen, the structure was completed in November 1996 and the bridge opened on 31 May 1997. Its novelties were conical ice shields that reduce pack-ice loads, very large precast components that shortened marine work constrained by the ice season, and a contractual 100-year design life. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
facts: 全長約 12.9 公里，是跨越冬季結冰海域最長的橋梁~About 12.9 km long, the longest bridge over ice-covered water
主橋段跨徑約 250 公尺，共約 44 個主跨~Main spans are about 250 m long, about 44 of them
橋面大部分高出海面約 40 公尺，航道段最高約 60 公尺~Most of the deck is about 40 m above the sea, rising to about 60 m at the navigation span
橋面寬約 11 公尺，雙向各一車道~The deck is about 11 m wide with one lane in each direction
設計壽命 100 年，約為一般橋梁的兩倍~Design life of 100 years, about twice that of ordinary bridges
約 175 件主要預製構件，最重約 7,500 公噸~About 175 major precast components, the heaviest about 7,500 t
高峰期每週完成一跨，施工期約 4 年、工人逾 5,000 名~At the peak one span was completed each week; construction took about 4 years with more than 5,000 workers
工程費約 10 億加元，1997 年 5 月 31 日通車~Cost about C$1 billion; opened on 31 May 1997
特許營運至 2032 年，之後移交加拿大政府~The concession runs to 2032, after which the bridge passes to the Government of Canada

timeline.event: 愛德華王子島公投以約 60% 支持興建固定通道~Prince Edward Island plebiscite votes about 60% in favour of a fixed link
政府與 Strait Crossing 簽署協議，10 月正式開工~Agreements signed with Strait Crossing, and construction begins in October
11 月最後一件主要構件就位，主體結構完成~The last major component is placed in November, completing the structure
5 月 31 日以步行活動揭幕後通車~Opens on 31 May after an opening pedestrian walk
特許營運期滿，預定移交加拿大政府~The concession ends with planned transfer to the Government of Canada
